entries.en: Yep. And just like I told him – I want it to be a surprise, but I somewhere all the girls from the office can see.
entries.ro: Da. Și cum i-am zis – surpriză, da, dar undeva unde să vadă toate fetele de la birou.

entries.en: Y'know, that new place downtown. It was perfect – sunset, drones, everyone clapped. Really took me by surprise.
entries.ro: Știi, locul ăla nou din Downtown. A fost perfect – apus, drone, toată lumea a aplaudat. M-a luat chiar pe nepregătite.
